reviews.author: Stephanie Cojocaru, Psy.D
reviews.text: This place was great from start to finish! I scraped my tundra door on accident and they made it look brand new in no time. Customer service was excellent, price was great, and quality of the work was excellent! Definitely recommend them

reviews.author: Jennifer Lange
reviews.text: I chose this place because they were closest to where my car broke down and they had good ratings. I was very impressed with how quickly they got my car back to me and the price was much lower than I expected! My last repair at a body shop was one of the big name brands and it took weeks. At Adam’s I was done in a few days. It turns out Adam’s had made a mistake in part of the repair, but they immediately fixed it and took responsibility. I definitely recommend them and will use them again.

reviews.author: Courtney Waid
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Dustin was kind, knowledgeable, and fixed my issues for a fraction of what another shop was going to charge me. So glad to have found Adams!

reviews.author: CerebralPrimate
reviews.text: Dustin was a total pro. Very honest in his dealings, fair price, and the work looks great. I felt lucky to have found this shop as all the ones near me were full after the big hail storm. He was able to get my vehicle into the shop without a huge wait, did the work just as he'd promised, and communicated with me about everything the whole way through. I cannot recommend this business enough.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Solesbee
reviews.text: Dustin and everyone is awesome, they do awesome work, fixed door where deer hit it, and repainted and striped perfect on a 24 year old vehicle and blended the paint perfect. Unbelievable work. Very prompt and reasonable priced. It is great to find someone who does great work and who is honest.

reviews.author: Jon Dunn
reviews.text: We have a 2023 CRV which had a dent in the back passenger door near the door handle. Dustin quoted an excellent price and it looks like new. The price quoted was significantly lower than two other major repair shops. He fixed our car a day earlier than his estimate which saved us on the rental car. We are very pleased with the price and service and recommend his shop.

reviews.author: Michael Shea
reviews.text: Dustin is a great guy and he knows his stuff. You can expect to be scheduled in but that's always the case with the good ones!

reviews.author: Stephen Kitz
reviews.text: Dustin did an outstanding job on my truck after it was in an accident. Repaired entire rear suspension and all the body work. He went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of. Absolutely satisfied and would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Peter Cappuccilli
reviews.text: I will never go anywhere else. Dustin bent over backwards to ensure everything would be prefect and he kept me in the loop during the process. He texted me every step of the way. He didn't charge us for the tow there, and he didn't take the deductible. We did bring him and his crew some holiday cheer as a small token of our gratitude. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kaci Sims
reviews.text: Dustin did a great job on my Tahoe that was ran into a parking pole. He did the job in a timely manner and it looks like new. Prices are resonable and him and his whole staff is very friendly and professional. We like his work so much we are taking my husband's truck in to get some work done as well. I will be using him for all future body work needs!

reviews.author: catherine Montsinger
reviews.text: This little shop is GREAT. Did body work for my 2019 Lexus and did a super nice job, at a great price and I had the car back in 2 days! They are my Go-To guys for all my body work from now on. Thanks Dustin!

reviews.author: Evans Auto Sales
reviews.text: Let Dustin do some body work on a 09 Fusion for me that was hit in the rear. The goal was to not replace sheet metal, and complete the work using a frame machine! Couldn't be happier with the work. Really no complaints at all. Color matched better than I expected. Just an all around great experience! Plan to take more back in the future!

reviews.author: Shirley Styles
reviews.text: Dustin Adams is an excellent paint and Body man. He has done repairs on a lot of our cars and for friends and family. Honest and reasonable. Try him next time you you hit something and your car or truck needs help. They don't disappoint.

reviews.author: gary evans
reviews.text: I had 2 repairs done there so far. Both times everyone was very friendly and helpful. Someone waits on you right away and I was never kept waiting. They did excellent work and don’t overcharge. I highly recommend .

reviews.author: Joyus2u
reviews.text: We have been to Adams Body Shop for more than one vehicle. The staff was very friendly and eager to assist . Adams staff kept in touch with throughout the process with updates and their work is impeccable! I appreciate their honesty and character and the fast service! I recommend Adams Body shop in Clover to all my friends and family. Thank you Adams Body shop for keeping a high standard of quality and honesty !

reviews.author: mikeberlak
reviews.text: Very nice repair and a great price after an unexpected run-in with a flooded road bent a fender out of position. Also surprised us with a no charge buff-out of a paint scrape from the garage door. Thanks, guys!

reviews.author: Mike Crowe
reviews.text: These guys were fantastic. In addition to being competitive, they got me in and out quickly, and made sure that I was completely satisfied. Would go back to them in a heartbeat

reviews.author: Edward Sykes
reviews.text: Great work and reasonably priced. I will be back next time I need work done. Thanks from SWEY Transport

reviews.author: Joey Cartier
reviews.text: Hands down the worst experience they lost my key it took them one week to find it... Definitely stay away from this place
